t: Merkle tree comparison — Replica Consistency Checker
title: Merkle tree comparison — Replica Consistency Checker
description:
The replica consistency checker makes sure every copy of the archive agrees: it compares replicas — by checksums, Merkle trees, or version vectors — and reports divergence with enough detail to repair. Replicas drift for ordinary reasons (a missed update, a partial restore); undetected drift becomes silent data loss or contradictory answers. The checker turns 'probably in sync' into a measured fact.

This record documents the merkle tree comparison approach: Compare hierarchical hashes top-down to isolate divergent subtrees without transferring everything.
